name: Tools of the Trade
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The wizards of the Kirin Tor at Ambermill have stored away important documents pertaining to the current state of Dalaran. This we know from the admissions of one of our prisoners. Lord Varimathras has placed the duty of recovering them in the hands of the Deathstalkers.

This task falls to you, adventurer. You will need some equipment, however, and the knowledge of lockpicking. Speak with Estelle Gendry, our outfitter, and ask her for a set of tools before you set out.
narrative.objectives: Find the Dalaran Status Report and return it to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter of the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Very good, adventurer! You have learned the fine art of lockpicking well, and faster than I could have possibly expected.

I see that I was right to place my trust in you. Believe me, boy, I foresee that you will go far in this line of work.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you located the documents, adventurer?
